notes: Import settings for scripts/buildAssets.ts. standardWheel: the one wheel size every car shares (meters), so cars read at the same scale next to each other; authored cars (assets/source/eshell/<carId>/<carId>.blend) place their Rig wheel empties at this radius and the manifest takes the width from here. cars: FBX imports under assets/source/icemaan/ (folders: candidate folder names; targetLength: overall body length in meters after scaling, the source models are roughly 3/4 scale; offsets in car space meters [x left, y up, z forward] added after automatic placement). The Wendt Fairway and Proto Compact started as IceMaan FBX imports and are now authored .blend cars, so they are not listed here.
